about: Europe/Madrid local slot of unix seconds, from Intl (the source src/timing.mjs localSlot uses). wd: Monday 0 .. Sunday 6; hour 0..23; block = floor(hour/4) (0 = 00-04 h); cell = wd*6 + block. Each vector is [t, wd, hour, block, cell, local text]. Spec.MadridSlot (Lua) must give exactly these for every vector. Rule: CET = UTC+1; CEST = UTC+2 from the last Sunday of March 01:00 UTC (inclusive) to the last Sunday of October 01:00 UTC (exclusive).
